Localization polish for the download-limit strings.

## Changed

- **The download-limit UI now reads naturally in every language.** The "downloads
  left" line is phrased so it reads correctly for any count — no broken
  "1 downloads" — and the download-limit option labels (limit toggle, max
  downloads, downloads-left) are now properly translated in all 26 languages
  (24 of them were English placeholders).
